rules.title: Exceptions Supersede General Rules
rules.summary: A specific rule from a feature, feat, weapon property, spell, magic item, or monster ability takes priority when it conflicts with a general rule.

rules.title: Round Down
rules.summary: Round down fractions produced by multiplication or division unless a rule explicitly says to round up.

rules.title: Rhythm of Play
rules.summary: Play cycles through the GM describing the scene, players describing their characters' actions, and the GM narrating the results.

rules.title: The Six Abilities
rules.summary: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma measure a creature's physical and mental characteristics.

rules.title: D20 Tests
rules.summary: When an uncertain action needs a roll, make an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll: roll 1d20, add relevant modifiers, and compare the total with the target number.

rules.title: Advantage and Disadvantage
rules.summary: When a D20 Test has Advantage or Disadvantage, roll two d20s and use the higher or lower result respectively.
